Decided 2026-10-20: accept Inductor+Triton parity. The deviation from eager comes from Inductor's tensorify_python_scalars pass (a Python scalar becomes a 0-d tensor op, so the scalar is converted to bf16 and no barrier follows), which runs before any backend; CubeCL output is bit-identical to Triton's. A backend fix would have to guess intent the IR no longer carries and would change kernels where Inductor already places barriers. Note the backend otherwise exceeds Triton via forced emulate_precision_casts, so this accepts the weaker guarantee here. Revisit if scoreboard error-vs-eager points at it; fixes would be upstream or specialize_float=True per workload. Tracked in the accuracy-vs-parity audit.
